versions.content: Handling if attempts to collect MACsec statistics at an Ethernet switch port has been finalized Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecGetMacSecStatistics was called for an EthSwtPort with EthSwtPortMacSecEnabled set to TRUE and the collection of the MACsec statistics for the corresponding Ethernet switch port has been successfully finalized, then the EthSwt driver shall perform the following actions: • set all statistics value which are not available (e.g. not provided by the hard- ware) to the maximum value of the used data type (e.g. for uint64 set value to 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) • notify the EthIf by calling EthIf_SwitchMacSecGetMacSecStatisticsNo- tification with SwitchIdx of MgmtInfoPtr set to to the corresponding EthIfSwitchIdx and SwitchPortIdx of MgmtInfoPtr set to the EthSwt- PortIdx Otherwise the EthSwt driver shall call EthIf_SwitchMacSecGetMacSecStatis- ticsNotification with Result set to E_NOT_OK .
